facts.statement: The Defenders must fight Baron Trampaoscura and his cronies until their training is complete, at which point they will defeat the Baron.
facts.quote: Su trabajo consiste en batallar a Barón Trampaoscura y sus compinches hasta que los defensores terminen su formación.

article_summaries.title: Conoce a los Defensores (Free Realms - Quoi de neuf ? page; Spanish text)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language SOE news post by principal game designer Chuck Kallenbach announcing the Heroes expansion for the Free Realms trading card game. It introduces four child Defenders (Bryce, Nathan, Onofre, Jessica), their decks, weapons and mounts, and lists new card mechanics such as multicolor boosters, stun-recovery cards and cards that clear stacked card piles. The page gives only a relative date ('Publié il y a 2 mois, 6 jours'), so no absolute date can be fixed.
